title: Krea 3 Ultra Becomes Top Non-Big Tech Image Model on Arena Boards
summary:
The independent startup's vision model earned 1435 points in the Multi-Image Edit Arena to place fourth among all laboratories, while ranking fifth in the Single-Image Edit Arena. Krea 3 Ultra is currently the highest-ranked image editing model not developed by OpenAI, Google, or Microsoft on the Artificial Analysis AA-Image-Editing v2.1 board, where it holds the fifth position overall. The model is second only to GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst in both Animation & Gaming and Frontier editing workloads.

The model ranks in the top seven across 15 of 17 editing categories and ties Microsoft's MAI-Image-2.6 with an Elo score of 1151, trailing Google's Nano Banana 2.1 by one point. Krea 3 offers two modes via its API: a "Fast" mode priced at $0.03 per 1K image, and an "Ultra" mode for 2K edits that costs $0.27 per image with one 1K reference. The company is the only lab in the top 10 of these rankings with a valuation under $1 trillion.

selectedTweets.text:
Krea 3 Ultra lands at #5 on AA-Image-Editing v2.1, with quality similar to Nano Banana 2.1 and MAI-Image-2.6

Krea 3, released on October 15, is Krea's new image editing model and its first on our Image Editing leaderboard. Today Krea adds Ultra, its highest thinking mode, alongside the default Fast mode, and we tested both modes through the Krea API at 2K resolution.

Krea 3 Ultra is the highest-ranked image editing model from outside OpenAI, Google and Microsoft. It places in the top 7 in 15 of our 17 Image Editing categories. Its best results are in Animation & Gaming and Frontier, at #2 in both. Krea 3 Fast, the default mode, lands at #11.

On the Krea API, Krea 3 Fast costs $0.03 per 1K image, plus $0.02 per 1K reference image. Krea 3 Ultra supports 2K output only, and costs $0.27 for a 2K edit with one 1K reference image.

Krea 3 is available on Krea's API and through other 3rd party APIs.

Congratulations to @krea_ai on the release!

See below for our analysis and example outputs of Krea 3 in the Artificial Analysis Image Arena 🧵
